title: A single nested-open restriction commutes with each canonical cohomology cone leg
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let I be a preorder, let D:I^op → Sch be a diagram, and let F_i be abelian etale sheaves on D_i [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Fix q≥0, i₀∈I, g₀:D_i₀→X, opens A≤B of X [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and put J=I_{≥i₀}. For W=A,B and j∈J put W_j=(D(j→i₀);g₀)^-1W. Set H_W(j)=H^q(W_j,F_j|W_j) using inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Let R_j:H_B(j)→H_A(j) be openCohomologyRestriction for the inverse-image inclusion [lem-weil-pbc-open-cohomology-whole-restriction-naturality]. Let c be a cone on D [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], let G:I→Ab(c.pt_et), let eG_i:G_i≅c_i^*F_i be specified isomorphisms, and let L be a cocone on G. Put W_L=(c_i₀;g₀)^-1W and H_W(L)=H^q(W_L,L.pt|W_L). Let R_L:H_B(L)→H_A(L) be restriction. Let λ_W(j):H_W(j)→H_W(L) be tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-cohomology-cocone-degree], with coefficient (eG_j)^-1;L_j. Then for every j and x∈H_B(j), R_L(λ_B(j)x)=λ_A(j)(R_j x). Neither c nor L is assumed universal, and no formula for arrows of G, cover, directedness, or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Functoriality of pullback and coefficient morphisms, specialized as parent proof step 1; Tag 09YQ for the restricted-system construction. Agent-written specialization.

proof.text: For a scheme map f:Y→X and nested opens A≤B of X and C≤E of Y, let a:C→A and b:E→B satisfy C.ι followed by f = a followed by A.ι and E.ι followed by f = b followed by B.ι. Cancel the monomorphism B.ι to obtain (C→E) followed by b = a followed by (A→B). This uses only the homOfLE_ι equations and associativity.

The private additive-homomorphism equality cohomologyMap_transported_comp_hom combines cohomologyMap_map, cohomologyPullbackFunctorial composition, and Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply after extensionality. With arbitrary coefficient maps l and k it identifies the whole composite H(k)∘a*∘H(l)∘b* with H(upperStarComp(a,b).hom followed by a*(l) followed by k)∘c*. This generalizes the existing pointwise transported-composition calculations in place; DFunLike.congr_fun evaluates the homomorphism equality at x in each square path.

Expand the two openSquareCoefficient maps and openCohomologyRestriction. Naturality of the inverse upperStarComp for C→E and E.ι moves the coefficient φ:f*F→G to the last factor. Apply the proved component associativity rearrangements upperStarComp_hom_app_map_upperStarComp_inv_app to (C→E,b,B.ι) and (a,A→B,B.ι), and map_upperStarComp_hom_app_upperStarComp_inv_app to (C→E,E.ι,f). Cancel adjacent hom/inv comparisons. The two composite coefficient morphisms now agree. Apply the transported-composition helper to both paths around the commuting square, and rewrite by this coefficient equality. This proves the private openSquare_restriction lemma without identifying opens with actual inverse images.

Apply openSquare_restriction with f=c.π.app(op j), stage opens tailStageOpen A and B, limit opens (c_i₀ followed by g₀) inverse images of A and B, restricted maps tailLimitOpenMap A and B, and φ=(eG j).inv followed by L.ι.app j. The two commuting-square hypotheses are Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι after expanding tailLimitOpenMap. Expanding tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree and the additive-group composition gives the statement exactly. No universality, coefficient cocone naturality, directedness, nonemptiness or nonempty-open hypothesis is used.

proof_origin.place: T2: direct commuting-square calculation with arbitrary coefficients, using the proved inverse-image component associativity rearrangements in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.BaseChange.Pasting; specialization to the tail cone squares from Tag 09YQ. mathlib_searches.query: Restriction between nested opens commutes with inverse system cohomology transitions and cone projection cohomology maps with arbitrary coefficient morphisms

For arbitrary nested opens A ≤ B of X, restriction from B to A on the limit inverse-image opens commutes with the actual cohomology leg from each tail stage. The coefficient map is (eG j.val).inv followed by the cocone leg. The cone and coefficient cocone need not be limiting or colimiting.
mathlib_searches.results: Eight general presheaf or inverse-system compatibility lemmas; none concerns actual etale cohomology transitions with openSquareCoefficient.
Only groupCohomology.exists_mul_galRestrict_of_norm_eq_one, unrelated to the scheme maps.

theorem tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree_restriction
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (L : Cocone G) (q : ℕ) {i₀ : I} (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X)
    (A B : X.Opens) (h : A ≤ B) (j : Set.Ici i₀)
      (x : Sheaf.H.{u + 1} ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (tailStageOpen D g₀ B j).ι).obj (F j.val)) q) :
      openCohomologyRestriction
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀).preimage_mono h) L.pt q
        ((tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c g₀ B F G eG L q j).hom x) =
      (tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c g₀ A F G eG L q j).hom (openCohomologyRestriction
        ((D.map (homOfLE j.property).op ≫ g₀).preimage_mono h) (F j.val) q x)
